definition: to give someone shelter in your home
description: An open front door at night on a wet street with rain falling. A soaked young woman with wet black hair, a navy raincoat and bare feet stands on the chequered tiled doorstep, smiling, holding a small ginger kitten against her chest. From inside the hallway someone in a white jumper throws a big yellow towel over her head and shoulders, and she steps inside wrapped in it, still holding the kitten and smiling. A yellow raincoat hangs on a hook and a lantern glows above the door.

taps.target: the person in the white jumper
